Finding.title: Client-controlled cookie is deserialized with pickle
Finding.originalRootCause: The /cookie route base64-decoded a browser-controlled value cookie and passed it to pickle.loads.
Finding.implementedChangeReviewed: main.py now defines encode_cookie_value and decode_cookie_value using JSON. The /cookie route calls decode_cookie_value for the incoming value cookie, catches invalid values, HTML-escapes display output, and sets cookies with encode_cookie_value.
Finding.comparisonToProposal: Matches the intended Scan Report-8 remediation for BF-STD-001 in substance. The implementation keeps client-side cookie storage but removes pickle deserialization from the client-controlled boundary.

verificationChecks.result: No pickle import or pickle.loads/pickle.dumps usage was found in main.py by the focused rg check.
JSON-encoded string cookie values round-trip through encode_cookie_value/decode_cookie_value.

Finding.technicalConclusion: Evidence indicates the original weakness is resolved within the tested scope.
Finding.technicalClosureRecommendation: Appears technically ready for closure review for BF-STD-001, subject to reviewer acceptance of client-side JSON cookie storage and invalidating old pickle cookies.
limitations: No malicious pickle payload was executed after the fix; verification used source review and focused tests.
Previously issued pickle cookies are treated as invalid rather than migrated.

Finding.title: DNS lookup route concatenates form input into an OS command
Finding.originalRootCause: The /lookup route concatenated request.form['address'] into an nslookup command executed through os.popen.
Finding.implementedChangeReviewed: main.py now validates addresses with validate_lookup_address and resolves them with socket.getaddrinfo through lookup_address. The /lookup route calls lookup_address and escapes rendered output.
Finding.comparisonToProposal: Matches the intended Scan Report-8 remediation for BF-STD-002 in substance. The implementation removes the shell boundary and validates host/IP input before resolver use.

verificationChecks.result: No from os import popen, def rp, or os.popen-based helper remained in main.py by the focused rg check.
test_lookup_rejects_command_metacharacters passed, showing example shell metacharacter input is rejected before lookup.
test_lookup_uses_resolver_without_shell passed with monkeypatched getaddrinfo returning a valid resolved address.

Finding.technicalConclusion: Evidence indicates the original weakness is resolved within the tested scope.
Finding.technicalClosureRecommendation: Appears technically ready for closure review for BF-STD-002, with the noted behavior change from raw nslookup output to resolver address output.
limitations: No real DNS/network lookup was required for tests; resolver behavior was tested with monkeypatching.
The output format changed from nslookup text to resolved addresses.

Finding.title: Expression evaluation route executes user input with eval
Finding.originalRootCause: The /evaluate route passed request.form['expression'] directly to Python eval.
Finding.implementedChangeReviewed: main.py now defines safe_eval_expression using ast.parse in eval mode and a strict operator allowlist. The /evaluate route calls safe_eval_expression and escapes rendered output.
Finding.comparisonToProposal: Matches the intended Scan Report-8 remediation for BF-STD-003 in substance. The implementation replaces general Python evaluation with arithmetic-only evaluation.

verificationChecks.result: No eval( usage remained in main.py by the focused rg check.
test_evaluate_route_renders_result_without_executing_code passed; arithmetic returns Result: 7 and malicious expression returns Unsupported expression.

Finding.technicalConclusion: Evidence indicates the original weakness is resolved within the tested scope.
Finding.technicalClosureRecommendation: Appears technically ready for closure review for BF-STD-003, assuming the intended feature only needs arithmetic expressions.
limitations: The evaluator supports only numeric constants and selected arithmetic operators.
No broad code-injection scan was performed; verification was limited to the original eval path and direct helper/route tests.
